value.rationale: Two labeled insertion depths control joint search-path costs but are not recovered from single-vertex marginals or a global path-length variance. Constant nonzero covariance coexisting with sharp total-variation asymptotic independence is a meaningful structural phenomenon; the logarithmic/iterated-logarithmic/positive-limit trichotomy at the summability boundary supplies a complete natural power-weight classification. Quantitative matching lower/upper rates prevent the result from being a mere recurrence reformulation.
